description_en: Queries information about cross-account network instances that are authorized to be associated with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeGrantRulesToCen接口查询云企业网实例已获得授权的跨账号的网络实例的信息
name: DescribeGrantRulesToCen

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.                   

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。                   

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

VBR: virtual border router (VBR) instance.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network instance.

VPN: IPsec connection.

ECR: Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例。

VPN：IPsec连接。

ECR：专线网关实例
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
If you do not specify the MaxResults parameter, you do not need to query results in batches. The MaxResults value in the response indicates the total number of entries.
If you specify the MaxResults parameter, you need to query results in batches. The MaxResults value specifies the number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. The MaxResults value in the response indicates the number of entries in the current batch. We recommend that you set MaxResults to 20
parameters.help_zh:
如果您不指定MaxResults参数的值，则表示您不需要分批次查询。调用接口后返回参数MaxResults的值表示列表条目总数。
如果您指定MaxResults参数的值，则表示您需要分批次查询，MaxResults的值表示分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。调用接口后返回参数MaxResults的值表示当前查询批次下列表条目的数量。建议指定MaxResults参数的值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent request exists.
If a subsequent request exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the network instance to query
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the network instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 网络实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: child_instance_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether IPv6 is enabled:
This parameter takes effect only when ProductType is set to "VPC".
A value of true indicates that IPv6 is enabled. A value of false indicates that IPv6 is not enabled. If this parameter is left empty, results are not filtered by this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启IPv6：
仅当ProductType = “VPC”时此属性有效；
true代表开启，false代表未开启，不填写或为空则代表不按此属性过滤
parameters.name: enabled_ipv6
